name: AL-38022A
summary: AL-38022A is a serotonin receptor agonist and psychedelic drug of the indazolethylamine family related to the psychedelic tryptamine 5-MeO-AMT. It is one of a range of similar drugs developed for scientific research and with some possible clinical applications such as in the treatment of glaucoma.

pharmacology.text: AL-38022A is a serotonin receptor agonist and psychedelic drug of the indazolethylamine family related to the psychedelic tryptamine 5-MeO-AMT. The drug acts as a potent and selective agonist for the 5-HT2 family of serotonin receptors, with highest binding affinity for the 5-HT2C subtype and around four times less affinity for 5-HT2A and 5-HT2B.
pharmacology.kind: Serotonin receptor modulator; Serotonin 5-HT2A receptor agonist; Serotonergic psychedelic; Hallucinogen

uses.text: It is one of a range of similar drugs developed for scientific research and with some possible clinical applications such as in the treatment of glaucoma.

sideEffects.en: Little is known about it in people. Drugs that activate the 5-HT2A receptor, the serotonergic psychedelics, can cause altered perception, anxiety, confusion, nausea and a raised heart rate.
sideEffects.zh: 它對人體的影響所知甚少。活化 5-HT2A 受體的藥物，也就是血清素類迷幻藥，可能引起知覺改變、焦慮、混亂、噁心與心跳加快。
sideEffects.zhHans: 它对人体的影响所知甚少。活化 5-HT2A 受体的药物，也就是血清素类迷幻药，可能引起知觉改变、焦虑、混乱、恶心与心跳加快。

fact.en: It swaps the indole ring found in tryptamines for an indazole ring, which carries one extra nitrogen atom. It came from the same Alcon glaucoma research as AL-37350A.
fact.zh: 它把色胺中的吲哚環換成了多一個氮原子的吲唑環。它與 AL-37350A 一樣，出自 Alcon 公司的青光眼研究。
fact.zhHans: 它把色胺中的吲哚环换成了多一个氮原子的吲唑环。它与 AL-37350A 一样，出自 Alcon 公司的青光眼研究。
